newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian wool indicator rises 3c to 625c/kg.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian wool indicator rises 3c to 625c/kg.

text.p: The Australian wool eastern market indicator rose three cents to 625 cents a kg clean on Wednesday at sales in Sydney and Geelong, Wool International said.
Merino fleece was mixed, with 19 micron one percent cheaper, 20/23m up to one percent dearer, 21/22m 0.5 percent dearer and 24/25m slightly cheaper.
Merino skirtings were up to one percent dearer.
In crossbreds, 26m was unchanged, 27/28/30m was slightly dearer and 29/31m slightly cheaper.
In cardings, lambs were unchanged, with locks slightly dearer and crutchings one percent dearer.
WI said Japanese and Chinese interests were principal buyers with good support from Western Europe and most sectors of the trade.
Of the 25,346 bales offered, 6.9 percent were passed in.
Sales continue on Thursday in Sydney, Geelong and Fremantle with about 38,780 bales to be offered.
